deviations: Paper LingBot-specific controller/native keyboard timing is not released; HY reference behavior is transferred explicitly.
Native frame-time chunk quantization and paused API calls differ from browser wall-clock control.
40Haiku requests is an explicit local budget definition, not verified paper LingBot interaction counting.
Exact judge alias currently404 with configured released client; preview scores remain qualified.

controller_profile.world_text: Rotate the camera 360 degrees clockwise in place, then return to the original angle facing the original view.

remaining_differences: No public LingBot player exists; this transfers HY-specific reference-guided behavior, not verified paper LingBot behavior.
Native generation pauses during SDK calls; released browser controls remain held while the request runs.
Released prompt uses the latest screenshot only, not an initial/current image pair or arbitrary history.
Decoded native frames replace browser screenshots; the released JPEG65 then640x360/JPEG45 preprocessing is retained.
Anthropic SDK replaces the released OpenAI-compatible HTTP proxy; malformed/API failures abort instead of silently continuing.
Raw response schema and served snapshot are now checked before the permissive released parser; this is intentional fail-closed hardening.
Only native camera controls are supported; avatar interactions and simultaneous keys are rejected, not synthesized.
caller_responsibilities: Canonical phase parsing, clock and angle calibration
Check cadence, minimum hold/release, phase progression and rotation-release policy
Global interaction budget and extension/correction application

controller_profile.native_capability: Camera rays only; no trained avatar-action channel is invented.
remaining_differences: Paper LingBot-specific controller/native keyboard timing is not released; HY reference behavior is transferred explicitly.
Native frame-time chunk quantization and paused API calls differ from browser wall-clock control.
40Haiku requests is an explicit local budget definition, not verified paper LingBot interaction counting.
Exact judge alias currently404 with configured released client; preview scores remain qualified.

timeline.method: Nearest cumulative boundary; explicit degree targets divided across their rounded phase steps
timeline.angle_binding: Text-number heuristic; not validated semantic grounding

reference_actions.source: released shared action DSL; no HY timing conversion

controller_profile.generation_blocker: Canonical controller and fixed-scale conditioning are integrated; full rollout hook execution and output provenance still require runtime validation.
controller_profile.scope: controller validation episode; not published benchmark reproduction

observation_encoding: lossless PNG before released JPEG stages

camera_diagnostics.scope: Intended camera commands only; not measured visual motion or goal completion.
